paragraphs.text: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, [even] Jesus;
paragraphs.original: Ὅθεν, ἀδελφοὶ ἅγιοι, κλήσεως ἐπουρανίου μέτοχοι, κατανοήσατε τὸν ἀπόστολον καὶ ἀρχιερέα τῆς ὁμολογίας ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν,
paragraphs.translit: Hothen, adelphoi hagioi, klēseōs epouraniou metochoi, katanoēsate ton apostolon kai archierea tēs homologias hēmōn Iēsoun,

paragraphs.text: who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.
paragraphs.original: πιστὸν ὄντα τῷ ποιήσαντι αὐτὸν ὡς καὶ Μωϋσῆς ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: piston onta tō poiēsanti auton hōs kai Mōysēs en tō oikō autou.

paragraphs.text: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.
paragraphs.original: πλείονος γὰρ οὗτος δόξης παρὰ Μωϋσῆν ἠξίωται καθʼ ὅσον πλείονα τιμὴν ἔχει τοῦ οἴκου ὁ κατασκευάσας αὐτόν·
paragraphs.translit: pleionos gar houtos doxēs para Mōysēn ēxiōtai kathʼ hoson pleiona timēn echei tou oikou ho kataskeuasas auton·

paragraphs.text: For every house is builded by some one; but he that built all things is God.
paragraphs.original: πᾶς γὰρ οἶκος κατασκευάζεται ὑπό τινος, ὁ δὲ πάντα κατασκευάσας θεός.
paragraphs.translit: pas gar oikos kataskeuazetai hypo tinos, ho de panta kataskeuasas theos.

paragraphs.text: And Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken;
paragraphs.original: καὶ Μωϋσῆς μὲν πιστὸς ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ ὡς θεράπων εἰς μαρτύριον τῶν λαληθησομένων,
paragraphs.translit: kai Mōysēs men pistos en holō tō oikō autou hōs therapōn eis martyrion tōn lalēthēsomenōn,

paragraphs.text: but Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we hold fast our boldness and the glorying of our hope firm unto the end.
paragraphs.original: Χριστὸς δὲ ὡς υἱὸς ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ· ὃς οἶκός ἐσμεν ἡμεῖς, ἐὰν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ τὸ καύχημα τῆς ἐλπίδος κατάσχωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: Christos de hōs hyios epi ton oikon autou· hos oikos esmen hēmeis, ean tēn parrēsian kai to kauchēma tēs elpidos kataschōmen.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore, even as the Holy Spirit saith, To-day if ye shall hear his voice,
paragraphs.original: Διό, καθὼς λέγει τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε,
paragraphs.translit: Dio, kathōs legei to pneuma to hagion· Sēmeron ean tēs phōnēs autou akousēte,

paragraphs.text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, Like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
paragraphs.original: μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ, κατὰ τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ πειρασμοῦ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ,
paragraphs.translit: mē sklērynēte tas kardias hymōn hōs en tō parapikrasmō, kata tēn hēmeran tou peirasmou en tē erēmō,

paragraphs.text: Where your fathers tried [me] by proving [me,] And saw my works forty years.
paragraphs.original: οὗ ἐπείρασαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἐν δοκιμασίᾳ καὶ εἶδον τὰ ἔργα μου
paragraphs.translit: hou epeirasan hoi pateres hymōn en dokimasia kai eidon ta erga mou

paragraphs.text: Wherefore I was displeased with this generation, And said, They do always err in their heart: But they did not know my ways;
paragraphs.original: τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη· διὸ προσώχθισα τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ καὶ εἶπον· Ἀεὶ πλανῶνται τῇ καρδίᾳ· αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰς ὁδούς μου·
paragraphs.translit: tesserakonta etē· dio prosōchthisa tē genea tautē kai eipon· Aei planōntai tē kardia· autoi de ouk egnōsan tas hodous mou·

paragraphs.text: As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.
paragraphs.original: ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου· Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.
paragraphs.translit: hōs ōmosa en tē orgē mou· Ei eiseleusontai eis tēn katapausin mou.

paragraphs.text: Take heed, brethren, lest haply there shall be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God:
paragraphs.original: βλέπετε, ἀδελφοί, μήποτε ἔσται ἔν τινι ὑμῶν καρδία πονηρὰ ἀπιστίας ἐν τῷ ἀποστῆναι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ζῶντος,
paragraphs.translit: blepete, adelphoi, mēpote estai en tini hymōn kardia ponēra apistias en tō apostēnai apo theou zōntos,

paragraphs.text: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called To-day; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin:
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθʼ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
paragraphs.translit: alla parakaleite heautous kathʼ hekastēn hēmeran, achris hou to Sēmeron kaleitai, hina mē sklērynthē tis ex hymōn apatē tēs hamartias·

paragraphs.text: for we are become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm unto the end:
paragraphs.original: μέτοχοι γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.
paragraphs.translit: metochoi gar tou Christou gegonamen, eanper tēn archēn tēs hypostaseōs mechri telous bebaian kataschōmen.

paragraphs.text: while it is said, To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
paragraphs.original: ἐν τῷ λέγεσθαι· Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, Μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν ὡς ἐν τῷ παραπικρασμῷ.
paragraphs.translit: en tō legesthai· Sēmeron ean tēs phōnēs autou akousēte, Mē sklērynēte tas kardias hymōn hōs en tō parapikrasmō.

paragraphs.text: For who, when they heard, did provoke? nay, did not all they that came out of Egypt by Moses?
paragraphs.original: τίνες γὰρ ἀκούσαντες παρεπίκραναν; ἀλλʼ οὐ πάντες οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐξ Αἰγύπτου διὰ Μωϋσέως;
paragraphs.translit: tines gar akousantes parepikranan; allʼ ou pantes hoi exelthontes ex Aigyptou dia Mōyseōs;

paragraphs.text: And with whom was he displeased forty years? was it not with them that sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
paragraphs.original: τίσιν δὲ προσώχθισεν τεσσεράκοντα ἔτη; οὐχὶ τοῖς ἁμαρτήσασιν, ὧν τὰ κῶλα ἔπεσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;
paragraphs.translit: tisin de prosōchthisen tesserakonta etē; ouchi tois hamartēsasin, hōn ta kōla epesen en tē erēmō;

paragraphs.text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that were disobedient?
paragraphs.original: τίσιν δὲ ὤμοσεν μὴ εἰσελεύσεσθαι εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ εἰ μὴ τοῖς ἀπειθήσασιν;
paragraphs.translit: tisin de ōmosen mē eiseleusesthai eis tēn katapausin autou ei mē tois apeithēsasin;

paragraphs.text: And we see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
paragraphs.original: καὶ βλέπομεν ὅτι οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν εἰσελθεῖν διʼ ἀπιστίαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai blepomen hoti ouk ēdynēthēsan eiselthein diʼ apistian.
